region_note: in_power = n < 10**m_prec, rsprite2's own rule for where GRIM/GRIMMER discriminate. Only in_power disagreements are evidence against either engine; the pin test requires zero of them.
note: Compares the FEASIBILITY verdict only. SPRITE's reconstruction is a stochastic search and two implementations will not return the same distributions; the analytic proof is the whole evidentiary surface. `search_exhausted` is counted UNDECIDED, never as impossibility -- a search giving up is not a proof.
